notes.title: Doggy Don't Care Receives $100,000 grant from Screen Australia
notes.content:
I’m absolutely thrilled (and a little in shock) to share that Doggy Don't Care 🐶 has been selected to receive a Games Production grant from Screen Australia!

Check out the [url=https://www.screenaustralia.gov.au/sa/media-centre/news/2024/09-04-2-million-for-australian-games-industry]official announcement[/url] and all the other great games selected!

[h2]I’m not alone in this anymore[/h2]
I have been making Doggy Don’t Care alone for over a year (maybe even nearly two years now) and I am proud of what I have achieved so far. June 2024 marked a turning point when I quit part-time work to focus on Doggy Don't Care full-time with hopes but no confirmation of securing funding.

Thanks to Screen Australia I am not only financially supported but I'm no longer in this alone. Rotub Games now has a graphic designer and composer on board to elevate Doggy Don’t Care to a new professional standard.

[h2]I did an interview[/h2]
By the way, I did an interview with [url=https://www.whatsitlike.com.au/doggy-dont-care/]whatsItLike.com.au[/url] about my journey to becoming an indie game developer and gave some insights into building Doggy Don’t Care. You can read it [url=https://www.whatsitlike.com.au/doggy-dont-care/]here[/url] if you’re interested.

Cheers,
Rotub

notes.title: Doggy Don't Care Demo Update!!
notes.content:
🚨 Demo update 🚨

Thank you so much to the thousands of demo players so far and for all the feedback!

I have taken the feedback and made some improvements for this version of the demo.

[u][b]Here's what's changed:[/b][/u]
🎶 New music
🦴 Snacks are now doggy biscuits
🛝 Play equipment in the garden/yard
🐕 Dog silhouette simplified
⏺️ Big button redesigned
🦄 Squeaky toys!
🐛 Bunch of bug fixes

I'm working hard on new levels and excited to show you more in the coming months! You can follow my progress on [url=https://x.com/rotub]X[/url].

Cheers!

notes.title: Steam Next Fest demo update and new trailer
notes.content:
The response so far for Doggy Don't Care has been amazing! I have been lucky enough to have the game featured in the official [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zQLCg46Q8nY&t=34s]Steam Next Fest trailer[/url]!

[previewyoutube=bs2ui1qyizA;full][/previewyoutube]

I'm incredibly grateful to all the players who provided excellent feedback and reported bugs. Here are some screenshots of the new demo below.

The demo takes place in a house and garden, but the full game will have more places. I have already started on two new environments (a farm and a museum!).

So stay tuned, wishlist the game, and follow me on [url=http://x.com/rotub]X[/url].
